domain: aerodynamics / airborne acoustics / wind load working fluid

substances.name: air
substances.notes: Dry air treated as an ideal gas with constant composition. Density from the ideal-gas law (R = 287.05287 J/(kg K), ISO 2533), dynamic viscosity from Sutherland's law, sound speed from the isentropic relation.

source.ref: Ideal-gas law with the ISO 2533 standard-atmosphere gas constant R = 287.05287 J/(kg K)
source.note: rho = P / (R T); at 15 degC and 101325 Pa returns 1.225 kg/m^3, the ISA sea-level density

density.accuracy: <0.1% versus ISA tables for 1 atm dry air (real-gas compressibility Z=0.9996 at 1 atm)
density.applicability: -50 to 50 degC, 1-1000 kPa; dry air, ideal-gas regime

source.ref: Sutherland law, constants of White, Viscous Fluid Flow (3rd ed.), Table 1-2 (air: mu_ref = 1.716e-05 Pa*s at 273.15 K, S = 110.4 K)
source.note: pressure independent to first order; returns 1.789e-05 Pa*s at 15 degC

viscosity_dynamic.accuracy: <0.2% versus tabulated air viscosity for 250-350 K

source.note: inherits the Sutherland and ideal-gas provenance

source.ref: Isentropic sound speed a = sqrt(gamma R T), gamma = 1.4 for diatomic air (ISO 2533 / ideal gas)
ISO 2533 standard atmosphere, cp = 1005 J/(kg K) for dry air
source.note: constant over the stated temperature band (<0.3% variation)
